items.title: Return completed wildlife-damage claim form and certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: The period runs from the letter's own date (document_date anchor), 21.11.2026 (Saturday), as stated in the letter itself — not from deemed delivery, since the letter expressly ties the period to 'dem Datum dieses Schreibens'. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts 22.11.2026. The letter defines 'Werktage' as Monday to Saturday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting 13 such working days from 22.11.2026 (skipping Sundays 22.11, 29.11 and 06.12, and checking NW public holidays, none fall in this window) lands on Monday 07.12.2026. That day is itself a working day, so under § 193 BGB no further shift is needed. Final due date: 07.12.2026.

warnings: The letter also mentions a voluntary information evening on 08.12.2026 about the insurer's online services; the letter itself says no registration or action is required, so it is not listed as an obligation.
